LIC Bids Rs 4,500 Crore in NSE IPO; Oversubscribed 5.7 Times

The National Stock Exchange (NSE) Initial Public Offering (IPO) concluded with bids totaling over Rs 96,000 crore, and was subscribed 5.7 times. Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) emerged as the largest bidder, applying for shares worth Rs 4,500 crore.
